title: Touch, taste, and smell are already mature in a newborn, who prefers sweet
summary: MedlinePlus says touch, taste, and smell are mature at birth, and that a newborn prefers a sweet taste.
body: MedlinePlus puts touch, taste, and smell in one sensory sentence: they are mature at birth, and the newborn prefers a sweet taste. The page, reviewed 1 January 2025, does not split those three into separate ages. It is not feeding advice, and it is not a taste trial. The references printed on the page are textbook chapters.

sources.title: Infant - newborn development
sources.author: MedlinePlus
sources.note: Supports the sentence that touch, taste, and smell are mature at birth and that the newborn prefers sweet taste.
